title: Ready Player One
author: Ernest Cline
summary: In a worn-out near future, most people escape into a vast virtual world. When its creator dies and leaves his fortune to whoever solves a hidden puzzle, a poor teenager joins a global hunt built on eighties pop culture.
readIf: you want a fast, playful treasure hunt packed with eighties games, films and music.
skipIf: you are not into pop-culture references or prefer more nuanced characters than this book offers.

pairings.reason: A wilder, funnier and denser cyberpunk take on a virtual world that helped shape this one.
The grittier, moodier ancestor of nearly every virtual-reality story that followed.
